entries.name: Mar Mushi
entries.description: The Old Testament figure Moses -- 'the Firstborn of the Prophets,' per the ACOE Diocese of California 2026 calendar, the only source found giving this identity a specific commemoration day. Disclosed rather than asserted with full confidence: the allowlist also carries other, more specific historical 'Mar Moses' figures elsewhere (of Chalek, of Beth Sayyare) not connected to this generic id, and Mushi/Mushe is the standard Syriac form of Moses -- this reading (the biblical Moses, not a later monastic of the same name) is the best-supported one available but not independently cross-confirmed by a second source. The identity id was previously scattered across three different unsourced dates (Jul.19, Aug.28, Sept.13) with no citation for any of them -- all stripped.
entries.ruleSource: Mar Moses, the Firstborn of the Prophets. THE CORRECT RULE IS KNOWN BUT CANNOT CURRENTLY BE EXPRESSED. California places this in the FIRST WEEK OF MOSES -- Mar Mushi on its Sunday (17 Oct 2021, 13 Oct 2024, 18 Oct 2026) and St Jacob the Recluse on its Friday (22 Oct 2021, 18 Oct 2024, 23 Oct 2026), both 3/3. Encoding that as a cycle rule was tried and REVERTED: js/calendar-east-syriac.js fails to produce a Muse week 1 in 5 years out of 20, because Muse is squeezed between an Eliya season built forward from Easter and a Hallowing season fitted backward from Subara, and can collapse to zero weeks. A rule that resolves to nothing makes the commemoration DISAPPEAR from the app, which is worse than a wrong date. Held as a fixed date (the 2026 value) until the season-collision defect is fixed -- see the dashboard row coe:engine:season-collision-2038, whose scope is far wider than the 2 years in 81 first measured. entries.description: SS. Peter and Paul. Source: Maclean 1894 (p.282-283, Kashkul MS list) and the ACOTE Diocese of Western Europe 2026 calendar, both independently giving this date -- already gathered in this project's own earlier research but never actually entered into the corpus until now. Distinct from the movable pre-Fast Friday joint commemoration of Peter&Paul with the Four Evangelists (deliberately not sourced here, since that date shifts year to year with the Denkha season length -- see the pre-Fast fold-schedule work).
entries.ruleSource: CORRECTED 2026-09-03. Was a fixed 29 July, which appears in no edition -- the commemoration is in JANUARY. The second Friday after the Epiphany: 17 Jan 2020, 15 Jan 2021, 14 Jan 2022, 20 Jan 2023, 19 Jan 2024, 17 Jan 2025, 16 Jan 2026. 7/7, exactly one week after St John the Baptist in every edition. The Four Evangelists are named with them in 2020, 2021, 2023, 2024 and 2026 and commemorated separately a week later in 2022 and 2025 -- that grouping is editorial.
